scope: 324 additional opening posts with sampled replies; not a quality audit of all historical records

entries.reason: Konkretny brak dostępu do Feroxy; żądanie kar i odpowiedzi rozszerzające temat nie tworzą jednej zweryfikowanej diagnozy.
Określona inicjatywa klubów LAN dotyczy fizycznych ośrodków sportowych, nie produktu Oteryn/Tibia.
OP wskazuje wizualne rozproszenie i proponuje konkretny redesign znacznika eksploracji.
Szerokie zarzuty o botach, RMT, inflacji i anty-cheat nie wskazują sprawdzalnego incydentu ani konkretnej zmiany; drugi post jest kontynuacją OP.
Problem dotyczy wielu różnych typów przedmiotów; kontynuacja OP prostuje pomylenie go z limitem 100 sztuk jednego typu.
Randomizer outfitu i mounta jest konkretny, lecz brak opisanej uciążliwej sytuacji produktowej.
Niechciana aktywacja przez wejście i manualne Use są jednoznaczne; to drugi dokładny sygnał obok 5000666.
OP opisuje zachowanie domyślnej ceny po aktualizacji i proponuje przełącznik NPC/Market; odpowiedź popiera.
Oba odczytane posty tego samego autora są edytowane do Delete; treść źródłowa została usunięta i poprzedniej wersji nie rekonstruowano.
Nostalgiczna opinia o kulturze firmy nie zawiera mechaniki, konkretnej sytuacji produktowej ani oczekiwanego wyniku.
Limity wyboru i odkładania tasków są konkretne; odpowiedzi sprzeciwiają się Store i proponują inną walutę.
OP opisuje trywialne wybory i utratę czasu prey oraz dwie konkretne zmiany: kategorię rerollu i pauzę.
Stash-to-Djinn sale, NPC relocation and dual-faction access are concrete but distinct proposals; one signature and dismissive replies add no argument.
Remote-house inconvenience and depot-to-house teleport are concrete; one support and one counterargument exist, while the insulting reply is not an argument.
Dopisek OP opisuje koszt leczenia i profit/h; niezweryfikowane liczby, jeden autor.
Heavy delivery items and completion from Stash or depot define a clear capacity and task-access change; weights and task rules remain unverified.

Terrain-specific mount movement is concrete; keeping the plus-10 speed does not remove the movement change. Three self-authored delete notices add no support, and a proposal alone does not establish problem recurrence.

The lunar expansion specifies lore, quest, environment, enemies, Echo use and a gear sink; it is a substantive proposal, not spam. Sink plus power does not prove anti-inflation, and the proposal is not independent evidence of a concrete problem.
Same author and identical OP body as earlier thread 4998346 post 39595384. Two IDs represent one text; the later copy adds no recurrence. The proposed change remains G2.
A five-tier Paladin potion ladder is specific, but all healing, mana, level and price values are unverified balance inputs. The proposal alone does not establish a recurring concrete problem.

The author explicitly calls the revenge summon a joke. The retained component is only a Q0 signal that Twist of Fate and blessing protection were misunderstood; the claimed 80 percent loss is not accepted as fact.
The OP says only this monster, with no name, image or mechanic, so neither the object nor the need can be identified.

The OP identifies concrete congestion, queue and training-dummy effects from global Double Events; only that problem signal is recurrence-eligible. The paid Battle Pass is a proposal, three substantive posts and the final dot are all one author, and paid Double XP and Skill change progression rate even when hunting time is required. P19 is only a policy analogy about prepaid tenure and Loyalty, not a general ban or a Battle Pass decision.
The four-target shield-Paladin attack and reply variant are concrete G2 changes. Same single-target damage does not preserve total AoE damage, and the reply's 5 plus 15 equals 20, not 25.
Limity stacku i slotów są konkretne, podobnie wartości 1000 i ×5; odpowiedź wskazuje cap jako dalsze ograniczenie.
Runewarden ma role, broń i czary, lecz sam opis nowej klasy nie dowodzi konkretnego problemu istniejącej gry.
Klasa pułapkowa ma szczegółową rotację i warianty, ale nie przedstawia konkretnego problemu jako podstawy powtarzalności.
Dostępność małego PvP jest rozpoznawalna; OP rozwija areny, matchmaking i balans, a jedyny inny uchwyt podważa wykonalność.
OP opisuje limit VIP w kontekście ról gildii, a tytuł wyznacza rolowe rozszerzenie; odpowiedź popiera.
Bottleneck leadera i prawo vice-leadera są konkretne; jedna odpowiedź to bump OP, druga popiera.
Meta broni i koszt ponownego treningu są konkretne; płatny transfer ma cenę, a odpowiedzi popierają lub wskazują trening.
Pościg PvP i ukrycie identyfikatorów są konkretne; 4998346 jest canonical, a 4998398 to kopia tego tekstu.
OP zawiera diagnozę i przebudowę żywiołów; odpowiedzi obejmują własny bump, odrębny wariant i powtórzenie 4998245.
Przestarzałe cele i koniec progresji są konkretne; propozycja ma poziomy, rangi i nagrody, a drugi post to kontynuacja OP.
OP chce usunięcia stamina, lecz trzy inne uchwyty preferują rework lub ostrzegają przed removal; nie są trzema głosami poparcia.
Zużycie timera na innych stworzeniach i creature-specific trigger są konkretne; dwie odpowiedzi krótko popierają.
A scaling sustain concern and multi-layer equipment regeneration design are concrete, but level pace and formulas are unverified.
Alleged dominant-guild denial of bosses and areas is a recognizable access problem; deleting all guild content is an extreme proposal and the allegations are unverified.
Basic-to-Powerful imbuement conversion is specific, but no concrete pain is stated; both replies are one author and the ratios and prices are speculative.
Perceived Sorcerer scaling and lost investment are concrete concerns, but uncontrolled maximum-hit anecdotes do not establish a nerf and no exact change is proposed.
The report-response gap and telemetry-to-human-review flow are concrete. Named accusations and the claimed 99.9 percent confidence are not verified facts.
Poor visibility of equipped state on action bars is a concrete presentation problem with a defined visual treatment.
Konkretny detal lore bez opisanego problemu, nie potwierdzony żart ani spam.
Potrzeba transferu z postrzeganego jako martwy świat jest konkretna; populacja i reguły niezweryfikowane.
Quest feedback, tutorial, alt access and three Market requests are separate components. The reply adds only a tutorial variant and does not support the whole package.
Level-band rebalance spillover and separate high-level spells are concrete; claims that level-1000 players destroy the game are opinions.
Solo Sorcerer concern and solo stance are concrete. Two later posts are self-bumps, yielding zero independent support.
Element resistance access and repetitive rotation are concrete; stance penetration and rune-like spells are G2 proposals. Both posts are one author and all example values are unverified.
Szczegółowe problemy i propozycje, lecz drugi post jest kontynuacją OP, a pomiary nie są niezależnie zweryfikowane.
Konkretny disconnect i reconnect proposal; założenie, że hardware token zastępuje autoryzację i zapobiega śmierci, jest nieuzasadnione.
Asymetria ścieżki i proponowane położenie noda są konkretne, choć intencja layoutu pozostaje nieznana.
Set bonus jest określoną propozycją nowej mocy; żartobliwe self-praise nie jest spamem ani powodem odrzucenia.
Usługa nazwy familiara jest konkretna, lecz odpowiedzi są żartami i nie stanowią poparcia ani problem evidence.
Wyjście do kalkulatora i konkretne pole quantity×price są czytelne; odpowiedzi są niemerytoryczne.
Pakiet zawiera konkretne UI/social/map mechanics; jedyna odpowiedź jest quote-only i nie zwiększa poparcia.
Brak informacji o Weekly Delivery i filtr yes/no są konkretne.
Problem outnumbering/dominacji jest rozpoznawalny, ale lista napraw pozostaje ogólna; odpowiedź wprost wskazuje brak mechaniki.
Toggle/buff są konkretne, lecz OP i odpowiedź sprzecznie opisują trigger oraz sens kosztu many.
Online training problem i weapon mechanics są konkretne; odpowiedzi proponują prostsze warianty.
Konkretna relacja ceny wykonania zasługuje na audyt, lecz jeden opis bez jednostek i reprodukcji nie dowodzi buga ani reguły.

Loyalty milestones are specific. Replies add concrete but conflicting accessibility and unused-points concerns: opposition to old-account power, support plus Store-pointing, and an unused-points concern; four authors are not consensus.
Adding specified pirate mobs to an existing task is concrete, but no independent pain is described.
Confusion among similar containers is concrete; user-local aliases preserve true item names and are presentation-only.
Capacity and Stash-to-NPC sale are concrete and recur independently in 4998403. Two replies criticize; the Monk-buff reply is off-topic and not support.
A purchasable tradeable task-point currency is specific but does not state a concrete pain. Calling it crypto does not prove blockchain, and a per-account cap does not guarantee supply control.
Ulus Frigo cost, cooldown and solo effectiveness form a concrete concern, but improve it is not a specified solution and all comparisons are unverified.
A cosmetic name font is requested without a pain case; the sarcastic reply is not evidence of need or support.
Metaphors about two worlds and a point of no return do not identify a problem, mechanic or expected result.
Marker clutter and persistent visibility layers are concrete. The same component appears in independent OP 4998253, giving two OP authors, not counting its quoted reply.
Depot assignment and auto-sort are specific without a pain case. One 1000x yes message is one supporter; a question mark adds no argument.
Spawn concentration and a broader delivery-item pool are recognizable, but claims that current delivery items revive spawns are unverified.
Późniejsza kopia OP 4998104 tego samego autora; 2 ID i 1 tekst. Odpowiedź pozostaje osobnym odczytanym postem.
Build comparison currently requires long noisy testing; the proposed authoritative simulator is concrete, while example damage values are illustrative only.
Canonical earlier copy of the exercise-weapon auto-chain request. Thread 4998106 post 39592931 repeats the identical OP by the same author, so the two IDs count as one text.

Spawn access and external coordination are a concrete need. One reply supports faster respawn, while the contribution tiers, current spawn scaling, dominance and retention claims remain unverified; zero contribution cannot automatically earn rewards.

The Lightning rotation complaint and chain proposal are concrete. The OP explicitly identifies the different-handle Monk as their alt, so those posts are one person; the sole independent reply opposes adding a chain.

The skill-to-Wheel conversion is specific and receives one signature, but threshold and Monk coefficients conflict internally, formulas are untested and existing-character migration is unspecified. No concrete pain case is established.

The temporary football event is substantive content with quest, encounter and rewards, not spam. It does not identify a recurring player problem, and item statistics and distribution remain unverified.
The paralysis-removal timing problem and one-second cooldown proposal are concrete and receive one short independent agreement. Minimal healing does not make faster cleanse timing parity-safe.
Double proficiency events and a paid boost are specific G2 proposals, but rates and claimed community acceptance are unverified and no concrete pain case is supplied.
Unreliable multi-click interpretation on touch hardware and one legal action per physical tap define a concrete same-outcome input ergonomics request; frequency remains unverified.

Two independent authors identify external spawn coordination and want an in-game path. The reply adds exact-location verification but does not endorse bonuses; damage, mitigation or loot bonuses are real G2 changes, not placebo.

Monk role ambiguity and virtue-specific spender mechanics are concrete. One independent reply is pessimistic rather than supportive, and the later bump is the OP; balance and bug claims are unverified.

Low Etcher desirability and the proposed discharge function are concrete, but demand and current item semantics are unverified. Removing remaining charge enables earlier recharge, so this is not presentation-only QoL.

Party exclusion and boss auto-attack contribution are concrete situations despite emotional language. One independent reply broadly agrees; the OP continuation is not another author, and the July balance state is not current proof.
Minimap scaling, transparency and local marker management are concrete. Two independent short supports add no argument; the final bump is the OP.
High-resolution UI scaling is a concrete presentation need with three independent signatures but no added evidence or argument.

Inactive-name scarcity and recycling are concrete, but inactivity and scale claims are unverified. The OP continuation is one author; an independent player returning after twelve years supplies a counterexample, not support.
Two fleeing creatures define a concrete control case and a two-target Fatal Hold proposal; current behavior and comparative vocation impact remain unverified.

Vocation-specific private spawn geometry and interference presets are concrete G1/G2 mechanics. The linked Imgur was not read, and claimed combat neutrality does not remove access, geometry or throughput effects.
The low-level sustain versus high-level scaling case and perk redistribution are concrete, but all damage, thresholds and future-change claims are unverified historical balance inputs.
Unused fishing-skill food and proposed stamina/stat fish are concrete. The reply redirects to a larger thread; its claimed reply/view counts neither verify that thread nor support these mechanics.
The isolated cooperative world type has specific high-level rules but supplies no concrete player pain case and leaves progression, abuse, population and economy mechanics undefined.
The read version contains only a disabled-post marker. The title says double post but cannot prove the source or content of a duplicate, so nothing is reconstructed or deduplicated.
Occupied spawns and lost limited play time are concrete. A two-hour per-player private instance does not cap simultaneous copies or global loot and XP output.
The Dawnport reuse and peaceful-island concept is a legitimate content candidate, not spam, but it lacks rules, encounters and a concrete measurable player impact for recurrence.
Interpersonal forum dispute about alleged AI style; no evidence of automation or game anti-bot issue. Accused handle intentionally omitted from analysis.
Weak high-level familiars and silent instruments are recognizable concerns; stronger summons, cosmetic variants, generative NPCs and music are distinct proposals.
Four separate Paladin mechanics are proposed. Both replies by the second handle are explicit satire and not support; the third post is the OP responding.
Staged Charm rewards and Weekly rerolls are distinct G2 proposals. Same final Charm total does not preserve reward timing. Staged rewards independently recur in 4998193.
House all-vendor Stash sale is concrete G1/G2 despite unchanged NPC prices. The 25 percent fee reply supports only a conditional variant, not the unqualified OP design.
Short Premium increments address a specific unused-time concern; one independent reply supports the same thread with a weekend variant.
Utevo Res upgrade gives a rough summon shape but no concrete pain, targets, stats, eligibility or expected balance outcome.

Weapon-class specificity and ST/AoE proficiency tuning are concrete. Replies by the second handle are satire; later OP update is not another author, and quoted external text is not an independently read post.
Monk light access and all-vocation duration variant are concrete; classification depends on whether light changes visibility, duration and resource cost.

Helmet sharing and Basic Scroll substitution are separate G2 components. The OP attributes the scroll idea to Itzfer, whose original post was not read, so it is not an independent source; satire and hostility add no support.
Neutral both-faction Djinn and depot-at-existing-Djinn are distinct G1/G2 variants. Satire is not support; the depot variant preserves faction choice but changes capacity logistics.
Helmet tradeoff is concrete; one reply agrees or suggests offensive identity, another proposes stats, and the final satirical reply is not support. All values remain unverified.
Two substantive posts are one author's ring-mode and regeneration proposals; the only reply is satire. Costs and balance values are unverified.
A detailed permadeath world proposal does not establish a recurring problem. Outfit, mount and set bonuses are gameplay power despite cosmetic framing.
Three authors identify recruitment clutter. Replies support the need but propose Party Finder as an alternative rather than independently endorsing a dedicated channel.
Mouse casting and a damage nerf are specified only at a high level. Same-geometry and same-timing input can be Q1; arbitrary angle or damage changes are G2.
Poison-arrow crafting is a substantive content candidate without a concrete pain case. Replies include a joke, one expansion and one preservation counterargument.
The new PvP world bundles collision, walls, red-trap rules, XP rates and one-way transfers. Demand, fairness and economic safety are unverified, and no single recurring problem is established.
Colored quivers address ammunition identification and receive one short independent agreement. The safe scope changes color only, not ammo, capacity or statistics.

City reputation, contribution, discounts, tasks, decay and invasion density form a new progression system. Cosmetic titles are separable; the package is G2 and supplies no concrete recurring pain case.
Returning from Market to Stash with prior filters is an exact repeated historical signal of lost interface context; current behavior still needs fresh verification.
Monk stance and damage-role concerns are concrete. Simon's reply links his own thread 4997885, so it is a variant by the same author across threads, not an independent second need.
Detailed Monk survivability, spender, virtue and Wheel claims plus proposed changes come from one author in two posts. The same author's link from 4997744 adds no independent support.

Two independent authors support protecting beginner Targuna but propose different level limits, 20 and 150. Posts 39592033 and 39592034 are the same text by one author three seconds apart, so they count as one reply, not two votes.
Detailed OP about Hive unlock and Bosstiary completion. Three captured replies contain no text and may be media or capture gaps, so they are not counted as support.
Custom ammo is a broad G2 proposal; one reply independently raises RP supply cost with a different conjured-ammo variant. The final reply is satire and not support.
Detailed leech rebalance proposal without independent measurements or a separately supported pain statement. The only reply is satire.
Death-loss pain has independent support, but replies prefer disconnect protection or stricter limits and do not support the unqualified stackable token design.

Single-author measurement suggests a spell/rune healing difference but same displayed base power does not prove the same formula. Removing a multiplicative 15 percent requires division by 1.15, so the author's times-0.85 check does not prove a bug.
Full graphical overhaul is an art-direction proposal; audience growth and hardware claims are not measured. Replies do not independently establish the pain.
Target-mode Use toggle is Q1 input safety; gem filter icons and persistent Back/history are Q0 UI. No automatic attack is proposed.
Solo Sorcerer positioning-versus-loot friction is concrete. A critical reply frames it as overlure/automation, while the OP clarifies normal combat flow; that criticism is not the audit verdict.
EK heal-overlap and burst dilemma is concrete, but a smaller mana pool does not guarantee that Mana Barrier prevents overlap or stays within survivability targets.
Buying future Premium for immediate Loyalty power is explicitly rejected by roadmap section 4.19.2. Separating Loyalty highscores does not remove purchased combat/progression power.
New independent proposal for Dust supply from Soulseal activity. Roadmap Training Arena zero-reward policy describes its test arena and does not establish runtime Soulseal behavior.

Key recognition and organization pain is concrete. Labels, organizer and objective hints are Q0 alternatives that preserve physicality; zero weight, no death loss and automatic door entitlement are G1/G2.
Resizable map control is a concrete presentation need; current limits remain unverified.
World transfer is requested without direction, rules or impact. The same Vlucia later posts dead-world transfer in 4998289, so this is not an independent author signal.
Earworm Bestiary credit and permanent spawn access are concrete but separate changes; current quest counting and lack of alternative spawns are unverified.
Two independent authors describe Monk scaling and party-role problems. Their damage, skill-ceiling and bug claims are historical and unverified; proposed Wheel, healing and barrier changes are G2.

Bulk same-world item transfer pain has one independent similar Djinn case. Parcel/Stash is an alternative, while the final reply adds no argument; proposed mechanisms differ in ownership and economy impact.

Affordability for casual and newer players is a concrete need, while inflation, gold-source causality, prices and play-time claims are unverified. Replies raise a distinct rare-item supply explanation.
The Monk complaint gives no combat context, mechanic or target. The sole reply is satirical and does not support the claim.
Two independent respondents give firsthand disconnect-death cases. A three-use monthly limit bounds frequency but does not prevent intentional protection use or prove genuine failure.

Two replies support hanging decorations. A third adds anchoring, doors and blocking, which is a separate access and permission change rather than support for decoration only; no recurring pain case is stated.
This OP independently states the Stash-to-Market context loss. A bump adds no evidence, a link is not read content, and one independent support does not verify the claimed weekly frequency.

A detailed recycling and salvage progression candidate receives one independent variant/support. Item destruction plus newly emitted residues and gear does not prove reduced inflation; accidental discard needs separate safeguards.
The title says Ctrl plus left click while the body says right click, so the binding is unresolved. Q0 applies only to opening already legally available target information.

Key identification and storage pain has one short independent support plus two different variants. Q0 labels/organizer are separate from G1/G2 automatic access or permanent unlock; Store access is not pure ergonomics.
Real self-reported cost of repeating alt access. Two ironic replies are by one author and are not two independent supports; account-world access maps exactly to P9.4.
Retro skull and Twist of Fate proposals change PvP and death rules. A single OP does not establish that these changes would revive server populations.
Mouse aim is Q1 only if area, timing, legal directions, cooldown and result remain unchanged. Winter-update claims are unverified and no separate pain is stated.
Earth/Ice stances and cooldown conversion are G2. Remove-stance can be Q1 only when it invokes the same legal action with unchanged timing and cost; no separate pain is stated.
Detailed coherent quest design, not spam, but it states no separate player pain. Guild access monopoly and rotating Premium are explicit goals and create high G2 product/economy risk.
One author across OP and addendum. Stash context maps exactly to P1.3; exact quantity is Q1, Buy/Sell distinction and persistence are Q0, and percentage tick size is G2.
Soul-core and boss-scroll-to-Wheel progression, Monk viability and Stash pain are distinct needs. The Stash reply is the same author as thread 4997356 and does not add an independent person.
Leech credit, proficiency credit and summon survival are real stated problems, separable from the extreme 9999 explosion buff. Satire and criticism are not support.
Bow proficiency coherence problem is concrete. A reply asking whether a future system will allow changes does not establish that the rework exists or resolves it.

Party-hunt observation is a real self-report, not telemetry; inflation is a forecast rather than fact. Personal accusations are omitted. One-button rotation and proficiency coherence are distinct concerns.
Small valid community-board sketch, not spam, but it states no separate pain and is outside the gameplay roadmap.
A distinct author independently repeats Targuna crowding, but proposed reward tiers and Soulseal costs are unverified G2 progression changes rather than QoL.
Rare access to an annual boss is a recognizable need, but fewer than ten spawns and all current scheduling details are unverified; no concrete solution is supplied.
A deliverable versus non-deliverable Stash filter is a concrete Q0 request when based only on authoritative item eligibility.

Four read posts are one author's broad hardcore-world design; later discussion was not read. Level-8 reset preserves griefing impact despite protected loot, while 2x recovery and per-character donations need abuse analysis.
Monk party and boss roles are concrete contexts, but all healing, magic-level and class-comparison inputs remain unverified historical balance claims.

One reply supports server-save reset, another identifies boundary camping, and the final post is the OP. Daily reset does not guarantee at most two kills in every rolling 48-hour window or bound burst supply.
Knight access to Great Mana Potions in daily rewards is a concrete class-parity proposal, but current eligibility is unverified and reward emission remains G2 even if the potion is usable.

Post-tutorial guidance is a concrete need. The PT-BR post is the same author's translation of the OP, not independent evidence; the other reply is satire. Guidance is Q0, Premium trial G1, and boosts G2.
Mac minimap-click inaccuracy is a concrete platform-parity bug report without independent reproduction or current testing; same legal destination and timing is Q1.
Moving a timed imbuement between compatible items is concrete. Preserving remaining duration still changes build flexibility and repeated maintenance sinks, so it is G2.
The indicator exposes the selected NPC, Market or custom valuation source. It does not prove the best sale price or that analysis was completed, so the bounded version is Q0.

A large Monk off-tank proposal explicitly labels numbers as placeholders. The continuation displays Marie Crimson but is edited by Mayor Crowny and reads as Final Thoughts, so it is not counted as confirmed independent authorship.
Edron detour is concrete and one reply opposes the change. Removing a wall changes world pathing and is G1; route labels alone could be Q0.
Swiftfoot cure, attack-debuff removal, mana, duration and speed are G2. A terrain-aware authoritative breakpoint display can be Q0; all values remain unverified.
New Stash/Inbox OP plus one independent reply reporting the same intended request. Another reply is the same author as 4997356 and does not add a new person.
Equal displayed attack does not establish equal AoE, level requirement or cost. Explanation/comparison is Q0; merging ammunition and changing NPC supply is G2.
Small valid mobile-client proposal, not spam. P1 scaling and input parity are prerequisites rather than a ready mobile-port programme; no separate pain is stated.
Boss-versus-XP stamina is a separate concrete problem. Paid house NPC combat buffs are G2 buyable power; the level-200-at-700-spawn claim and values are unverified.
Imbuement slot design has broad independent support; fist-food absence is a separate stated need. Parity with other vocation rewards still changes power and remains G2.
Forge attractiveness is a personal self-report. Tier-5/tier-10 math and inflation effects are not endorsed without a combat/economy model; a stronger sink does not guarantee lower net inflation.
Specific 1080x1200 eight-inch handheld readability report maps directly to Q0 UI/font scaling in P1.1.
Angry wording still contains a concrete two-hour access self-report. Two satirical replies are not support or votes.
Whole-set loadout is Q1 only under existing timing and item constraints; instant equip is G2. Market deep links and favorites are Q0.
Alliance Chat has one independent explicit support. It is G1/Q1 conditional on consent and guild-role permissions and is not evidence for a combat alliance pact.
Dodge is a Charm major/minor slot issue, not a craftable rune. Moving or adding defensive packs changes opportunity cost and power; equipment proficiency is a separate proposal.
Monk access to Superior Mana Potions in daily rewards parallels the Knight GMP request 4997652. The generic critical reply is not an independent reward-table report.
Physical-only Bane Bringer damage and Explosion Rune effectiveness are competing unverified claims. The reply offers an alternative rather than confirming current resistance rules.

The 95/98 ratio is not 3.06 percent; 3/98 may describe the increment's share of the total but not final damage. Item value also includes eligibility, resistance and defense tradeoffs, so the post does not prove BiS uselessness.
A Bazaar character's inherited addon allegedly changes Iksupan charges from the desired three-loop behavior to 99. A toggle changes access and hunt tempo even though the trigger is cosmetic.
Three OP posts are one author's report, source text and correction. A reply claims two errors remain but does not verify all corrections; safe Q0 editing must preserve puzzle and lore semantics.
IP-change disconnect and death risk form a concrete resilience report without reproduction. Authentication details remain a security design decision; no automatic trust in IP or tokens is inferred.
Random teams, 4-to-8 limits and one-time boss access are proposed restrictions, not verified current behavior. Guild and bot allegations are unsupported and omitted from factual recurrence.

Persistent light and repeated casting are concrete, while replies offer untested hotkey, equipment, duration and ambient-setting alternatives. Presentation is Q0; removing resource or cast constraints is G1/G2.
Mouse-directed wave ergonomics are concrete. Q1 applies only with the same allowed direction, cone, range, damage and timing; the post does not request arbitrary-angle permission.

The aiming burden and Death Echo proposal have one independent contributor posting twice. Seventy percent is a requested target rather than a measurement, and the linked image was not read; no medical inference is made.

Before-and-after max hits do not control target, resistance, build, buffs or sample size and may compare different enemies. Replies criticize the claim but do not prove either a nerf or that the OP is false.

Optional premium permadeath is a detailed proposal without separately established pain. Historical and waiver/legal claims are unverified author assumptions; removing PvP XP does not eliminate griefing.
Repeated event mechanics and low participation are concretely reported. Punitive no-loot invasions remain G2 through damage, travel disruption and grief potential.

Ruse/tier perceived value is a real signal with one independent mixed counterpoint. Higher baseline defense does not prove percentage dodge worthless; marginal value, cost, mean mitigation and risk variance differ.
Language accessibility is concrete and retention impact unverified. Q0 localization requires canonical IDs and stable NPC keywords/puzzles; it must not automatically translate command execution.

OP continuation is the same author; one reply is a joke and the later objector repeats author 4997409 across topics. Proposed 500-to-501 and 750-to-751 price cliffs, binding and reduced resupply sink require full modeling.
Remote-house friction is concrete. Paid house teleport changes traffic, travel and location value; death respawn is a separate variant rather than support for the bidirectional teleport.
Positive EK ergonomics and competitiveness counter-signal, not spam or telemetry. Personal health details are omitted; no change is proposed.
Player TC trade transfers gold rather than minting it. A 10kk Premium sink requires defined payer, payee and burn; paid travel unlock changes access and logistics as G1/G2.
Two text posts are one author's coherent boss proposal; the third is unread media. Zero-reward 24h loser lockout and one-player veto create collusion and grief risks at high-level access.
Concrete sprite preference expressed profanely; public analysis uses a neutral description. Art/readability remains Q0 if item identity and gameplay stay unchanged.
Shield Slam debuff icon and duration display map to Q0 Active Effects only when driven by authoritative server state.

Four-cardinal-quadrant mouse aim is Q1 if geometry and server rules remain stable; autoloot is G1/G2. One independent reply supports both needs but is one source, and Store payment does not prove a net gold sink.

Two angry but concrete OP posts are one author describing fleeing, paralyzing monsters and Fatal Hold availability before Bestiary unlock. The reply suggests alternatives without verifying current behavior.
XP lottery odds and price are design inputs, not evidence of neutral balance. Existing boost rewards do not make a new gold-purchased progression source parity-safe.
Universal ammunition and rune NPC catalogs change logistics, access and regional supply. The public house-NPC reply is an unverified alternative, not proof the need is solved.
The OP's streamer-motive allegations are unsupported. Ares repeats the damage complaint later recorded in 4997483, so this does not add a new independent author signal.
Twenty-hour weapon decay and repair are concrete G2 upkeep. The design can force returns and weaken equipment, so it does not guarantee preserved gameplay or balance.
Focus or resize allegedly closes panels, and the OP requests both layout persistence and an individual backpack lock. These are Q0 when item and world state remain unchanged.
A new OP independently resembles Inferniarch concern 4997523. The bump adds no support, and two reply variants with different values are proposals rather than validated balance targets.
Sanctuary mitigation, auto-cast and cleave are concrete G2 proposals. The reply is a bump plus speculation about development cadence, not an independent case.

The OP quotes 4997440 but adds its own experience, toggle and color design, so it is not an exact duplicate; the quoted author is not another contributor. Color can be Q0, while permanent light and a new imbuement slot are G1/G2.

Vocation conversion is G2. Hyd's two posts are one respondent; Bazaar is a counterexample that does not preserve the same character's name, quests, skills and Bestiary, and a future service is speculation.

Two authors support character-bound imbuement loadouts. It closely matches P7 library and active channels but remains G2 because cost, lifecycle and equipment demand change despite equal simultaneous power.
Separating already-owned helmet and weapon visuals can be Q0 when ownership and permissions stay identical. New addons, rewards, assets or purchases are separate product scope.
Species changes power, access and permanent PvP as G2 rather than cosmetics. A reply's lore interpretation is not verified canon.
Concrete sprite preference; general bug allegations have no examples and are not counted. The personal accusation is omitted.
English and Spanish OP are one text. Two independent replies support Monk balance; the third respondent translates the second and gives language guidance rather than adding a third support.
Death Echo always inheriting stance element is G2 despite being labeled consistency because it changes damage type and resistance interactions.
Detailed Monk shield-slot item stat list without a separately stated pain; valid proposal rather than spam.
Accidental transform supports Q1 protection. The author's NVM corrects skill-versus-attack interpretation, so the initial formula is not treated as fact; buffs are separate G2.
Separate OP flags missing newer potion rewards while explicitly acknowledging price may be relevant. Adding free potion supply is G2.
Three OP posts are one author and one reply independently raises weak-value equipment slots. Helmet and amulet tradeoffs lack proof that every compared or proposed item is BiS.
18-to-15kk party raw is one player's uncontrolled self-report rather than telemetry. A five-person party bonus changes progression and is G2.
Same author/reasoning as 4997502; 8 then 4 percent are variants, not sources. Two other authors support redesign. 90/93 is not a 3.23 percent damage proof and skill ratio is not the damage formula.
Exploration/lore project without separately stated pain. Catalog can be Q0 only for legally discovered data; entry tickets alter access/rewards as G1/G2.
Crafting RNG stats, repair, durability and sinks are G2. One respondent supports this OP; 30k views and 100 replies refer to another thread and do not support this OP.
Fishing and cooking with combat buffs are G2. Random monsters do not prove anti-macro effectiveness, and linked threads' claimed views or replies are not support read in this sample.
New stronger runes and water or air elements are substantive G2 content proposals without a concrete recurring pain case or balance inputs.
Market mastery markers and a permanent-progression tab are Q0 only when displaying authoritative states. Unknown or incomplete historical migration must be explicit.
Every number is a fictional profile mockup, not a real player's data. Self-view can be Q0; public exposure requires granular consent and should keep finances and play time private by default.
Single-modifier reroll or targeted selection changes Greater Gem outcome distribution and build cost. One signature adds no data, and Tibia Coin spending is not automatically a gold sink.
Element conversion for AoE ammunition and physical spells changes damage type and access despite being called a fix; current eligibility and formulas are unknown.
Two proposal posts are one author, and the reply does not confirm a need. Attack-speed buffs can raise total party output despite XP, loot, mana or defense penalties.
Weapon Proficiency session feedback is Q0. Use actual server delta per weapon, handling swaps, bonuses, credit and zero duration; 100,000 is illustrative and 474 kills do not prove it.
Two independent authors report NPC chat window friction. Layout or visibility is Q0; preventing accidental focus from blocking movement is Q1 input safety.
Local appearance or streamer masking can be Q0. Server-public inspect must not be hidden without an explicit rule and granular consent; the post does not establish armor rendering on avatars.
Cursed weapons are a G2 power and economy proposal without a recurring pain case. Percentage drain and high upkeep do not by themselves guarantee a balanced tradeoff.
Merging elemental gems reduces RNG and build cost, while new gems add bonuses. This is G2 even though the proposal reads like a catalog cleanup.
New Daily Reward potion proposal without separately stated pain. Adding free potion supply is G2.

All four posts are one author; quoted Averemos is not a captured respondent. Hunt style and rune self-target are real stated needs, while proposed test values and a May 22 OP edit do not establish current runtime.
Concrete Monk party/value self-report. Sixty-percent damage and three-times cost are not controlled measurements.
OP continuation retracts the bug interpretation and acknowledges misunderstanding priority instead of cycling. Q0 explanation is appropriate; Multi-Cycle is Q1 only with one legal action per input.
Weekly tags/filter are Q0 with three respondents; the third supports only the filter and questions the icon, while custom tags are a variant.
New Daily Reward potion supply is G2. Positive balance feedback is a separate qualitative counter-signal rather than telemetry.
Paid Gift of Life reset is G2; price and limits do not guarantee safety or prevent abuse.
Avoid automatically maintaining distance four changes movement and kiting as G1/G2; only moving interface icons is Q0.
Damage dummy closely matches P6.5 Training Arena when it gives no rewards, XP, loot or progression.
Dynamic buffer formulas are G2 proposals without evidence they meet safety, class or abuse targets.
Retro 7.x nostalgia is a valid preference, while a guaranteed return of thousands is not fact. A historical server/client is outside the current Evolved roadmap.
Online-training difficulty after Full Defense removal is concrete. An AI-translation label is not spam evidence; new weak-weapon or training rules are G1/G2 and require diagnosis before tuning.
Wheel plus gems saved profile is Q1 only within existing legal constraints, with no free reroll or bypass of costs and eligibility.
Bestiary tracker shortcut is Q0 if it does not reveal unknown creature data or bypass discovery eligibility.
Mount equipment and abilities change power and access as G2, including Store-power risk, despite one short supportive reply.
Cosmetic sales are a commercial decision separate from Twitch XP, boost, training and task rewards, which are G2. Non-tradeability does not erase recipient advantage.

Fairness and report-response risk only. Claims about platform protection and 50-60kk are unverified, do not prove a loophole or guilt, and are not a basis to exclude operating-system users. No exploit details or accused profiles are retained.
Copy/paste action configuration is Q0/Q1 and does not execute combat automatically.
Another independent Great Mana Potion Daily Reward proposal; adding free potion supply is G2.
Task Point fees are not a gold sink. Main-character world alone does not validate actual item destination. Safe same-rule transactions are Q1; auction, fees and delivery change liquidity as G1/G2.
Map markers are Q0. Cosmetic discounts are a separate commercial proposal, and the claimed promotion history is unverified.
One extreme delivery-cost case does not establish the distribution. Reroll changes demand and source selection as G2; P17 controller is the direct mapping.
Old-equipment drop increases are G2 economy changes; scarcity is unmeasured. Q0 source and upgrade-path guidance is a separate alternative.
Inventory item imbuement icons and active-effects sidebar solve different cases. One respondent clarifies multiple stored/equipped instances, so existing sidebar does not remove the problem.
Pre-release Echo RNG forecast does not confirm rate or 719, but it preserves a valid need for predictable collection progress and maps directly to P10.
Thirty-day EXP ranking is Q0 using lawful public data. Network-identifier joke and accusations are neither support nor implementation proposals.
Elemental bolts change boss coverage, ammunition supply and combat power as G2; no separate pain is stated.
Limited play time is a real need without retaining personal details. Three-times/five-times Prey and stacking are G2 and cannot be treated as harmless to others.

Posts 39588079 and 39588080 contain identical text by one respondent and count as one support. Translation is Q0 with opt-in label, original text, vendor privacy and no automatic translation of executable commands or prices.
Role preference plus unbreakable two-to-three-SQM weapons alter combat and ammo economy as G2. Banter replies are not support.
Real alternative single-target style need. Equal HP/time does not guarantee equal risk/reward or AoE/single-target parity; one reply wants lower rewards.
Concrete Monk basic-attack role clash in bosses with three separate G2 variants requiring target-band validation.
Bed upgrade gives paid training/stamina power as G2. Two replies are one author, and an earlier quoted statement is not another captured post.
Wand/rod damage is felt weak without numbers; it is a P15/P6 candidate, not automatically a confirmed bug.
Weekly Boss Tasks map to P14/P11 as G1/G2 with two independent supports and an OP continuation. Seven calendar days do not imply a maximum seven kills when cooldown may be twenty hours.
Wrong-world friend referral is concrete onboarding friction. Q0 preview and Q1 choice must show only eligible worlds; a third reply's 95 percent is opinion rather than retention data.
Perceived low elemental weapon variety is concrete, but one respondent supports only the broader concern and not the exact holy-weapon solution; lore commentary is not mechanics evidence.
Role and level matchmaking maps literally to P3. A private instanced dungeon is a separate G1/G2 world-access and economy change from the respondent's open contested raid variant.
Three authors express a concrete situational-music preference, but they do not provide independent evidence of a gameplay problem; safe implementation is Q0 using already-authoritative state.
A reply reports an existing authenticator but does not verify it. Cryptographic keys and SMS require separate account-security threat and recovery review; SMS is not assumed safer.
Talisman perks for Weekly Tasks and point-paid task choice are separate G2 variants in the literal P14 domain; the reply does not independently confirm the OP's exact pain or proposed costs.
The proposed vocation-specific condition cleanses are G2 class-balance changes without separate evidence of a current coverage problem; a joke reply is not support.
Residual ring and amulet charges create concrete friction. Charge transfer is close to P4 normalization but changes uninterrupted protection duration and requires atomic value conservation as G1/G2.
Two independent disconnect-death reports support the pain, while loss figures and causes remain uncontrolled. P12 compensation and P18 abuse analysis still apply on Optional PvP.
Merging rods can conserve charge count yet extend unattended session duration and reduce interaction frequency, so it is a G2 P8/P17 training-cadence change rather than neutral QoL.
Fragmented Market, Cyclopedia and external lookup is concrete UI friction. Existing lawful NPC and known-task data can be presented as Q0 under P5/P14 without changing prices or transactions.

A short basement and second-floor proposal is concrete rather than spam, but it states no separate player pain and does not count toward problem recurrence. It belongs to P16 and requires G1/G2 validation of map topology, access, capacity and house value.
Wings grant movement and protection bonuses and are therefore G2 power rather than cosmetics. The proposal conflicts with P16's non-mandatory-power goal and needs P6/P11/P15/P17 review.

The OP reports MultiAction repeat friction, accepts a respondent's intentional-design explanation and closes the thread. This is not a verified bug or an automation instruction; the OP continuation is not independent support.

Two authors give concrete arguments that offline magic training becomes less useful, while another gives a counterargument. Post 39587294 includes bump language but substantive evidence and is not bump_only; reported levels and durations remain unverified.

A broader character skin-tone palette is a concrete cosmetic proposal without replies or independent problem evidence. The unverified attributed historical rationale is unnecessary to preserve the request.

Client-only lighting can be conditional Q0 presentation of lawful scene data. The reply's resistance, stamina and food auras are a separate G2 power system and do not independently confirm the OP's visual friction.

Daily Bestiary XP and permanent creature mastery are separate G2 reward variants. The OP's arithmetic is wrong: 700*100*0.5 is 35000 and 700*1000*0.5 is 350000; whether threshold rewards stack is unknown, and the quoted OP continuation is not independent support.

Merging sword, axe and club is a G2 P8 classic-skill migration with item, character and proficiency consequences. The OP's distance-skill line is sarcasm rather than a literal design, and the OP continuation is not independent support.

Offline exercise progression can be G1 only under P8's unchanged rate, effectiveness, eligibility, cost and legitimate resource use. Gift of Life recovery during training is a separate G2 death-recovery change.

Manual Battle List filtering and sorting can be Q0/Q1 client UX over lawfully visible entities. The source does not authorize automatic target selection, and hidden-entry effects on manual target cycling require explicit semantics.
A high-level one-handed spear is a concrete G2 itemization, shielding and vocation-balance candidate. Proposed stats, price and claimed neutrality toward the AoE meta are unverified.
The short request to refresh Grizzly tasks is a concrete P14 suitability signal rather than spam. Claimed low use of the assigned creatures remains unverified.

Two authors frame stamina as a punishment for extended activity, while a third frames it as a healthy-play bonus. Both sides are qualitative opinions rather than telemetry, and the linked external thread was not read as evidence.

A fixed higher denomination preserves nominal value but changes transaction capacity and logistics, requiring G1/G2 atomic conversion and audit. The variable-value puzzle coin is a separate G2 reward design and is not support for the same denomination.
A player describes a concrete accessibility barrier and a manual front-tile Use binding. Q1 must define object selection and preserve the same range, rights, cadence and errors as ordinary Use.
One author proposes a country-registration-based temporary cosmetic entitlement. Skepticism and football banter are not support; private registration country must not be exposed or inferred.

Nineteen ideas across three OP posts remain one author's mixed package, not nineteen independent signals. Combat is G2, VIP/net-worth presentation can be Q0, and manual sio/exiva target binding is Q1.
The manual healing-target friction is concrete, but this is the same author and idea later repeated in thread 4997074, so it is not a second independent author. Three bump posts are not votes.
Paid random Weekly Task rerolls with XP decay and new combat-stat rings are separate G2 designs. Both need progression and economy simulation; the detailed numbers have no independent support.

Two authors support a broad Classic+ direction while differing on scope, and the OP changes the design. A reply quotes text absent from the preserved edited OP; popularity forecasts are unverified and an AI accusation is not evidence.
Font scaling, console colors and per-attack life/mana-leech aggregation address concrete readability friction as Q0. Aggregation should retain accessible raw event detail.
Dinosaur Island is a broad but concrete content theme rather than spam, yet it lacks a full map, encounter and economy design. A 3x3-creature remark is not evidence of an engine limit.

Three authors support distinguishing Weekly Delivery items, though one prefers custom categories and the OP bump is not another vote. Current required items and the full potential delivery pool must be separate filters.

Two authors independently describe the pain of separating potential future Weekly Delivery items, strengthening recurrence with thread 4995718. The quoted OP text in the reply is not an additional vote.
This is a short, concrete frustration with Ragged Rabid Wolves rather than spam. Removal or reweighting is G2 and needs task, spawn, effort, completion, reward and economy data.

Hypothetical equipment and workshop simulation is Q0 and must not buy, grant or equip items. Wheel-plan import is separate Q1 with full legality checks; publishing is opt-in, and claiming no drawbacks is only an opinion.

Paid Bazaar character clones and a 5% XP or skill return to the source character are G2 character-supply and purchasable-progression changes. Unnecessary alleged credential history was omitted and no such data was sought or opened.
The captured post contains only deleted, so no problem, proposal or argument can be recovered from the checked source.

Three authors support task-progress visualization. A Q0 Grizzly progress bar must use the same authoritative current and required counts rather than duplicate progression state; popularity impact remains unmeasured.

The OP expects account-scoped use while a respondent reports character binding and Bazaar transfer. Neither account nor character scope is verified; a G1 entitlement model must define house rights and prevent duplication during Bazaar transfer.

Remote postal NPC selling has independent general support, but quest unlock and fees do not preserve travel logistics, making it G1/G2. Player delivery contracts are a separate G2 custody and reward economy rather than corroboration.
Two authors support Monk self-UH during fear, a G2 sustain and crowd-control response change. Party positions on the minimap are a separate Q0 proposal limited to permissioned lawful location data.

The aggressive post still states concrete disconnect-death friction and a voluntary PvE logout proposal. Claims about opponents' motives are not evidence; voluntary logout removes boxing and aggro risk and is a separate G2 rule from connection-loss protection.
Floor friction is concrete movement friction, but formulas and level effects are unverified. Changing it is G2 because route timing, low-level PvE positioning and PvP chase or escape all change.

Armor and defence scaling is a concrete G2 balance concern without measured formulas. Player armor or defence and creature mitigation are separate sides of the damage pipeline and must not be conflated.
A statue or plaza is a community-recognition proposal rather than a gameplay problem. Personal insults were omitted, and post-count claims or opinions were not converted into a ranking of people.

Replacing the Bounty Talisman Bestiary benefit with permanent combat power is a contested G2 proposal. Two respondents challenge the premise, the OP continuation is not independent support, and claims about future creature additions remain unverified.

The summons rework is a substantive G2 class and Skill Wheel design despite an aggressive dismissal. The fourth post gives concrete reported current-use counterexamples that require verification; the OP continuation is not independent support.
